paragraphs.text: The Official Tournament Player's Guide is a guide to Magic: The Gathering tournaments with complete DCI regulations presented by The Duelist . It was published in June 29, 1999, and thus severely outdated. It is a softcover paperback with 142 pages.

The Official Tournament Player's Guide is a reference book for all players at all skill levels. Everyone who plays or judges MAGIC: THE GATHERING competitively, whether in local tournaments or top level DCI championships, and will find this guide indispensable.
Review the complete DCI Floor Rules and MAGIC technical rules
Learn to enter the tournament scene
Introduction by Garon Galloway, Arena Commissioner at the time.
Official Magic: The Gathering standard floor rules
